attacks.name: Automatic Pistol
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make one additional |*Automatic Pistol| attack. This additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Make It Personal
steps: |!wild| |*Insult to Injury|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Make It Personal| attack without paying the |!power| cost. The additional attack must target the original defender and is a |!mystic| attack instead of its normal type. This additional attack does not have the |*Insult to Injury| special rule.

superPowers.name: Red Mayhem (Affiliation: Cabal)
superPowers.body: During the |*Cleanup Phase|, resolve the following effects in either order:|\||~ Roll a die for each objective token contested by an allied character. If the result is a &!critical&, &!wild&, or &!hit&, Push each enemy character contesting the objective token Away from it &!range_small&.||\||~ Roll a die for each enemy character holding an Asset token within &!range& 2 of an allied character. If the result is a &!critical&, &!wild&, or &!hit&, the enemy character drops 1 Asset token of your choice.|

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Partners in Crime
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's Activation, if it is within |!range| 4 of an allied |*Brock Rumlow|, this character may use this superpower. If the allied |*Brock Rumlow| does not have an Activated token, he may Activate before your Turn ends.

superPowers.name: Heir to the Wicked
superPowers.body: When this character is damaged by an enemy or allied effect, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 4 to 6 on Healthy side.
"Make It Personal" power cost decreased from 4 to 3.
Partners in Crime special rule now refers to |*Brock Rumlow| instead of |*Crossbones|.
Red Mayhem reworded, its two effects can now be resolved in either order.
